bioconda.name: chemembed
bioconda.summary: Metabolite identification from MS/MS spectra using molecular embeddings
bioconda.description:
ChemEmbed identifies metabolites by transforming an experimental MS/MS
spectrum into a learned molecular embedding with a convolutional neural
network, then ranking candidate structures from a reference database by
cosine similarity against that predicted embedding.

Models and the reference database are not included and must be supplied
separately.
